description: This Java class 'RetrievePolicyStrategy' is a final class that handles the retrieval of policies within a command/query framework. It extends an abstract strategy class to implement the application logic for processing 'RetrievePolicy' commands, including returning policy data or errors if not found. It also manages entity tags for optimistic concurrency control.

classes.name: RetrievePolicyStrategy
classes.description: Final class that implements a strategy for handling 'RetrievePolicy' commands within a policy persistence context. It constructs results based on whether the policy entity is found or not, and manages entity tags.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Processes the 'RetrievePolicy' command, returning either a query result with the policy event and headers or an error result if the policy is not found.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an optional EntityTag derived from the new policy entity if it exists, used for concurrency control.
